verdict.rationale: First-party docs say incidents can be declared right from Slack or Microsoft Teams, and the product is sold as chat-native incident response. Incident channels are implied by references to updates and discussion in the incident channel, and AI Suggestions automatically draft incident updates. Nothing in the pack documents automatic assignment of incident roles, and channel creation is only implied, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: documented automatic incident-channel creation, documented role assignment (e.g. incident lead), Teams-specific run-the-incident detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, I can declare and run an incident from chat — Slack or Teams — with channels, roles, and updates created for me

citations.quote: Declaring an incident takes seconds, and you can do it right from where your team already works, whether that’s Slack or Microsoft Teams.
Slack or Microsoft Teams native incident response
Connect pull requests and get updates in your incident channel.
incident channel discussion and change events
Suggestions uses AI to help teams communicate better during incidents by automatically drafting updates, summaries and follow-up actions based on your incident activity.
